skill.name: find-skills
skill.description: Search skills.sh, clawhub.ai, and GitHub for agent skills, compare native popularity signals, and apply basic safety checks before recommending a skill.
skill.summary: Find agent skills across major registries with popularity and safety context.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, comments, safe temporary files, /dev/null redirects, or grep patterns used to scan candidate skills. The confirmed issues are expected read-only network calls to public registries and local enumeration of installed skill folder names. I found no prompt injection, credential reads, remote code execution, or auto-install behavior.

remediation.issue: User queries are sent to public skill registries.
remediation.suggestion: Document this clearly and add an option to disable specific registries when privacy matters.

remediation.issue: Installed skill folder names are read from hidden home directories.
remediation.suggestion: Add a flag to disable local installed-skill detection and explain what local metadata is shown.

remediation.issue: Remote candidate skill bodies and archives are downloaded for heuristic scanning.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce response size limits and keep archive extraction restricted to the expected SKILL.md file.

content.user_title: Find Trusted Agent Skills Across Registries
content.value_statement: Finding the right AI skill is difficult when each registry shows different signals. This skill searches multiple registries, compares native metrics, and highlights basic safety signals.
actual_capabilities: Searches skills.sh, clawhub.ai, and GitHub topic results from one script.
Ranks each source with its native popularity metrics.
Shows the top candidate from each board with source health and latency.
Marks likely installed skills from local skill directories.
Fetches top candidate SKILL.md files and applies heuristic risk flags.
Can emit formatted terminal output or machine-readable JSON.
limitations: Requires jq and curl; GitHub results need the gh CLI.
Results depend on public APIs and network availability.
The security scan is heuristic and not a full audit.
Installed-skill detection can miss renamed folders.

use_cases.title: Choose a Task Skill
use_cases.description: Find a published skill for a user request before building the workflow from scratch.

use_cases.title: Compare Registry Signals
use_cases.description: Review installs, stars, match rate, and source coverage before recommending a skill.

use_cases.title: Check Candidate Safety
use_cases.description: Scan top installable candidates for risky patterns before asking the user to install one.

prompt_templates.title: Find One Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a common task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a skill for [task]. Search adjacent terms and recommend one primary option with clear evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Registries
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare skills for [domain] across skills.sh, clawhub.ai, and GitHub. Explain fit, popularity, and safety signals.

prompt_templates.title: Vet Installable Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [task], scan the top five installable results, and exclude risky candidates unless no safer option exists.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Recommendation Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Run adjacent searches for [need], read the best candidate docs, compare signals, and produce a concise install recommendation.

output_examples.input: Find a skill for Playwright test automation.
output_examples.output: A primary recommendation with registry source, install count, fit rationale, and any safety warning.

output_examples.input: Compare skills for dashboard UI design.
output: Top results from skills.sh, clawhub.ai, and GitHub.
One recommended skill with alternatives for narrower needs.
Notes about missing sources or unscanned candidates.

output_examples.input: Check whether I already have a good documentation skill.
output_examples.output: A list of relevant installed matches and a recommendation to reuse one when it fits.

best_practices: Run adjacent-term searches before deciding that no good skill exists.
Read the top candidate documentation before recommending installation.
Treat risk badges as prompts for manual review, not final audit results.
anti_patterns: Do not recommend a skill based only on the first search result.
Do not treat a clean badge as proof that a skill is safe.
Do not install a skill without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Does this skill install other skills automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends candidates and shows install guidance, but installation must be user approved.

faq.question: Which registries does it search?
faq.answer: It searches skills.sh, clawhub.ai, and GitHub repositories with common agent-skill topics.

faq.question: Does it need API keys?
faq.answer: No API keys are required. GitHub results need the gh CLI if that section is used.

faq.question: What data leaves the machine?
faq.answer: The search query and candidate registry identifiers are sent to public registry APIs.

faq.question: How reliable is the security scan?
faq.answer: It is a heuristic scan for common risky patterns. It does not replace manual review.

faq.question: Can it work without GitHub CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The GitHub section is skipped or degraded when gh is unavailable.
